collection.description: After a severe storm, two builders argue over a steeper roof or a cooler, wider one: build steep, or build cool.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: The last storm tore the roofs off five huts. (subject) wants every new roof built steeper, so the rain runs off and the wind cannot grab it. (friend) says steep roofs make the huts unbearably hot in summer, and wants wide eaves and gaps to let the air through. What should they build?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: The new roofs are steep. They survive the next storm. In summer, the huts are like ovens, and people sleep outside. (subject) adds a few small gaps under the eaves, quietly.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: The new roofs are wide, with gaps for the breeze. The huts are cool all summer. The next storm lifts one roof. (friend) ties the gaps shut in storm season. Both of them learn something.
